#pragma once
#include <string>
#include <vector>

namespace yacht {

class score_card {
public:
    score_card() = default;
    explicit score_card(std::vector<int> dice);
    int score(const std::string& category) const;
    template <typename F> int fold(F f) const { int acc = 0; for (int d : dice_) acc = f(acc, d); return acc; }
private:
    std::vector<int> dice_;
};

int score(const std::vector<int>& dice, const std::string& category);

}  // namespace yacht
